plugins.name: tracer
plugins.description: Which session did what — a structural index over Claude Code's own transcripts, verbatim, no LLM pass. Its own command, `tracer`: `tracer sessions` (what is running, what was asked, how it went) and `tracer trace` (every tool call, a turn's steps, the sessions that touched a file). Plus /tracer:trace, :blame and :index, and a Stop hook that keeps the index current. Needs uv; no other plugin.
